---
title: "Course Schedule"
---

This page includes the course schedule for the Fall 2026 semester, along with all the assigned readings and graded events.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Accessing the Assigned Readings

The assigned readings can be accessed via the links below or in the Course Letter.

*OpenIntro Statistics* and *Introduction to Modern Statistics* are both available as a free e-book. The readings for this course will come from four digitally available textbooks, from the links in the course letter, also provided below:

-   **David Diez,** **Mine Cetinkaya-Rundel, and Christopher D. Barr.** OpenIntro Statistics, 4^th^ Edition. Free PDF available at [https://openintro.org/book/os/.](https://openintro.org/book/os/){target="_blank"}

-   **Mine Cetinkaya-Rundel and Johanna Hardin**. *Introduction to Modern Statistics*, 2^nd^ Edition. Free web-native version available at [https://www.openintro-ims.netlify.app](https://www.openintro-ims.netlify.app){.uri target="_blank"} (may not work on MissionNet).

-   **Chester Ismay, Albert Y. Kim, and Arturo Valdivia**. *Modern Dive (v2).* Free e-book available at [https://moderndive.com/v2/](https://moderndive.com/v2/){.uri target="_blank"}.

-   **Bradley Warner, Brianna Hitt, and Ken Horton**. *Computational Probability and Statistics*. Free e-book available at [https://ds-usafa.github.io/Quarto-Book/](https://ds-usafa.github.io/Quarto-Book/){.uri target="_blank"}.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" icon="false"}
## Fall Calendar with Course Assignments

To view the graded events for this course, overlaid on the Fall 2026 academic calendar, click [here](DS220_Fall2026_Calendar.pdf){target="_blank"}.
:::
